name: Verdandi
source:
Verdandi is one of the three Norns. Her role within the Norns is to be the defender of the timeline in the present. She rarely intervenes however and only does so if the threat is imminent and threatens not only the present, but the past and future as well.

She is a very powerful fighter. None know the full extent of her power due to the rarity of her appearances, but no one has been capable of besting her when she does come.

[In game description]
